description.value:
I'm not hiding (RaintDM), this change is also purely intentional so that the Bard can use this weapon. It seems to me that, conceptually, a weapon that buffs your allies in combat using music is entirely Bardic, but Amellwind's homebrew takes the weapon purely as MH presents it, which is fine. However, I'm taking the creative liberty of making some changes so that it's possible for a Bard to use it.

Open Hunting Horn filters on 5e.tools

Features

Mastery (Topple)

If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Strength or Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

Instrument of War (The Bard Fix)

This weapon doubles as a musical instrument and a spellcasting focus. If you have the Bardic Inspiration feature, you gain proficiency with this weapon, it loses the Heavy property for you (allowing Small races to wield it comfortably), and you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls.

Recital

Bonus Action.

The horn relies on the momentum of combat to generate its magic. When you hit a creature with this weapon on your turn, you can use your Bonus Action to perform a Recital. You activate one Melody from your Songbook (see below). The Melody emits a 15-foot aura centered on you that lasts for 1 minute, until you are Incapacitated, or until you activate a different Melody.

▸ Upgrade — Encore

Bonus Action.

Your mastery over the horn's acoustics improves. When you use your Bonus Action to perform a Recital, you can have two different Melodies active at the same time.

Songbook

You know two Melodies of your choice. You can change your known Melodies whenever you finish a Long Rest.

▸ Upgrade — Expanded Songbook

You know three Melodies.

Melodies

Melody of Might

Allies in the aura (including you) can add [[/r 1d4]] to the damage rolls.

Melody of Swiftness

Allies in the aura have their Speed increased by 10 feet and ignore Difficult Terrain.

Melody of Warding

Allies in the aura gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class.

Melody of the Harmful Elements

When you perform this Recital, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Allies in the aura deal an extra [[/r 1d4]] damage of that type.
